messages:
sarah_product: FYI — Blueleaf (enterprise) asked to pin model version `llama3-13b-v1` to eu-west-2 for regulatory validation. They also want an int8 quantized variant and the version pinned for 12 months. Sales request from @mike_sales. They validated outputs on v1 and cannot move to v2 yet.

mike_sales: Confirmed. Blueleaf is in PCI scope and willing to pay for dedicated capacity if needed. Timeline ask: 3-4 weeks. I'll share PO/compliance docs once legal confirms.

anya_eng: Quick engineering note — can `llama3-13b-v1` run on A10G pool with `q4_0`/int8 path? We saw perf/regression quirks on earlier v1 kernels. Need model artifacts + hash to validate.

raj_infra: A10G is workable but we'd want 2 nodes for redundancy at their expected TPS. Autoscaling ok but Dedicated reservation required for guaranteed throughput. Also need model stored in EU cache and KMS key access.

lina_support: Let's capture acceptance criteria from support side: 1) parity checks against their validation set (100 sample prompts), 2) pinned model hash & versioning in catalog, 3) audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM, 4) documented rollback plan.

chris_catalog: Catalog status — we don't currently list `llama3-13b-v1` in eu-west-2. To onboard I need: model package (or S3 pointer), SHA256 hash, quant config, and intended serving config (batch sizes, seq len). I can spin onboarding job once we have artifacts.

sarah_product: Proposed scope for intake: (A) pin v1 in eu-west-2 as a dedicated/pinned variant, (B) produce int8 quant and perf report, (C) canary rollout with health gates, (D) audit/log export enabled. Launch criteria: perf within 10% of hosted baseline, successful parity tests, and docs + contract signed.

eva_pm: Recommend prioritizing this as P1 enterprise intake since sales will cover Dedicated. We should create a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria and link to contract.

mike_sales: I'll create the intake ticket and attach PO + compliance pack. If PO arrives today can we commit to 4 weeks?

anya_eng: With PO and artifacts, eng estimate is ~2w for perf/compat validation, 1w infra work for capacity & KMS, 1w for rollout/canary — so 4w is reachable if nothing blocks. Need early access to the model weight file.

raj_infra: I'll pre-author estimate and tentatively reserve capacity in eu-west-2, but will need finance sign-off if Dedicated over threshold. Blocking: model upload + customer KMS grant.

deploy-bot: New intake created: IN-4578 by @mike_sales — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-4578

sarah_product: Action items recap: mike create intake + add PO, chris request model hash & package from customer, raj reserve capacity & confirm KMS flow, anya start perf bench once we have model. Tag me on updates. :thumbsup:
